description: Authored exact-caption fallback lines. No voice audio is bundled or claimed generated. NONE means silence. HEARD_RHYTHM requires accepted sustained elevation AND near creature; it is fiction, not a fear/health diagnosis.

lines.text: Containment failure. Field team, proceed to the emergency observation shelter.
The shelter is sealed. You have a terminal, three remote emitters, and one emergency isolation switch.
Silence the faults. Test the emitters. Route the signal back into containment.
The sedative is wearing off. Working makes noise. Staying here does not finish the protocol.
Select the box marked FAULT, or press its number. Leave the quiet boxes alone.
Press Q to isolate the equipment. The illuminated switch works even in a blackout.
Wait for receding footsteps. The sound captions give the same information.
Hold F for one second to restore power. Your progress is saved.
Watch four pulses, then repeat their numbers. R replays the same sequence.
The selected emitter is already set. Press T when the sequence is calibrated.
Eight faults. Work at the terminal. Isolate the machines when you hear the proximity alarm. Do not wait for it to reach the wall.
Machines quiet. It may still investigate the last sound. Prepare emitter A.
Five pulses. Repeat the sequence and send the heartbeat to emitter A.
The remote signal has it. Clear twelve overload faults before it comes back.
Seven faults across the rack. More than one may be active. Work one at a time.
Overload cleared. Emitter B will lead it toward the containment approach.
Six pulses this time. Calibrate emitter B and move it toward containment.
Route confirmed. Final containment broadcast is available.
Press T to activate the final lure. The containment system will seal after it enters.
Containment broadcast active. Remote capture sequence running.
Containment confirmed. The emergency protocol is complete.
Main power lost. Emergency isolation remains available.
Breach attempt. Press Q to isolate equipment now.
Footsteps receding. Hold F to restore equipment.
Pulse signal unavailable. Gameplay is using neutral settings.
Baseline recorded. Pulse input is active.
I heard that. Do it again.
You made it quiet. I know you are still in there.
A rhythm behind the wall.
Over there.
The marked boxes are faults. Q buys quiet time; it will not finish the work.
There is no penalty for replay. Press R, repeat four inputs, then T.
Shelter integrity lost.
I can hear you working.
